library(httr)
library(jsonlite)

query_api <- function(key) {
  # Set up the API endpoint URL
  url <- paste0("https://taginfo.openstreetmap.org/api/4/key/chronology", "?key=", key)
  
  # Send a GET request to the API endpoint
  response <- GET(url)
  
  # Check if the response was successful
  if (status_code(response) != 200) {
    stop(paste("Failed to retrieve data from API. Status code:", status_code(response)))
  }
  
  # Convert the JSON response to a data frame
  data <- fromJSON(content(response, as = "text"), simplifyDataFrame = FALSE)
  
  # Convert the data to a data frame
  df <- data.frame(
    id = data$tag,
    date = data$date,
    nodes = data$nodes,
    ways = data$ways,
    
  )
  
  # Return the data frame
  return(df)
}
